visual_language.direction: classroom chalkboard deck, dark slate field with chalk-stroke line work, slightly diffused dry-medium edges, sketched boxes brackets and arrows, off-white chalk carries most marks, powdery pastel accents used sparingly, chalk-dust grain, nostalgic instructional warmth

content_review.reviewer_note: 结构完整（负面约束+密度映射在案）：候选晋升，需 U3 语义审阅补主题绑定与特征后转 active

legacy_payload.best_for: 以深石板场、粉笔笔触线稿与粉彩粉笔强调的板书语言,做教学、教程与课堂讲解;怀旧而有秩序,一板一焦点
legacy_payload.visual_direction: classroom chalkboard deck, dark slate field with chalk-stroke line work, slightly diffused dry-medium edges, sketched boxes brackets and arrows, off-white chalk carries most marks, powdery pastel accents used sparingly, chalk-dust grain, nostalgic instructional warmth

canvas.background: 深石板板面 #1E3A5F(藏青石板场,板尘质感),板面即呼吸位
canvas.composition: 黑板教学法:分区组织 + 明确中心焦点;粉笔框/括号/箭头做结构与推导线

color_palette.rule: deck 的颜色以「软粉感粉彩」出场,克制稀疏——永不饱和填充;强调只用于下划线/圈注/关键词;备选「粉彩粉笔层」(chalk pastel layer)彩粉笔板:chalk yellow #FFE566 / pink #FF9999 / blue #66B3FF / green #90EE90 / orange #FFB366——同页出场 ≤4 色,一律以粉感透明度/噪点出场(HEX 本身满饱和,粉感靠透明度实现),不做饱和填充;deck 显式声明 poly-pop 制式混搭时可用下的备选色板

typography.title: 手写粉笔字气质标题(Caveat / Kalam / 霞鹜手写系),干性笔触感
typography.body: 可读正文(思源黑体 / Nunito),白色粉笔感
typography.labels: 小注与图例同手写气质,粉彩点色

layout_patterns: 标题区 = 粉笔下划线 + 手写大标题,顶角可缀粉笔星点
内容 = 粉笔草图框/括号/箭头组织区块,推导过程逐步画出
章节页 = 满板单焦点:一词/一式/一图居中,板面留黑呼吸
图示 = 粉笔简图(线稿 + 少量粉彩填色),禁照片感
legacy_payload.layout_usage_rule: 一板一焦点,黑板教学法:粉笔框组织分节,推导线讲过程;粉彩只做点睛
negative_prompt: no saturated marker fills — accents stay powdery pastel
no mechanical vector edges; chalk strokes stay confident but slightly diffuse
no dark-theme neon glow; this is chalk dust, not cyberpunk
no crowding — the board reads as room
legacy_payload.palette_family: macaron(粉彩粉笔)/ duotone(双色板书);源规格颜色行为分离——粉笔纪律是风格本体,HEX 可被品牌侧替换

visual_elements.allowed: 粉笔笔触线稿,草图框/括号/箭头,下划线与强调符,粉笔星点,板尘颗粒
visual_elements.avoid: 饱和马克笔填充;机械矢量边缘;霓虹辉光;照片写实

rendering_constraints: Depth comes from chalk-stroke weight, not material; flat board, no drop shadows.
Chalk-dust grain across the board is on-brand.
Handwritten baselines sit slightly uneven — the imperfect baseline adds classroom authenticity.
Chalk dust and eraser smudges appear across the board as authenticity cues, not dirt.
